zh: 设初始时所有长度为 k 的窗口里，1 最少的窗口有 q 个 1。无论怎么操作，第 t 次操作前最多只删掉了 t−1 个 1，所以前 q 次操作的费用至少依次是 q、q−1、…、1，之后每次至少付 1。
这个下界能达到：先反复选那个 1 最少的窗口，把它清空，正好付 q+(q−1)+…+1；之后从这段全 0 的窗口向两边一格一格滑动，每遇到一个新的 1，窗口里只有它一个 1，付 1 删掉。总费用是 T+q(q−1)/2，T 为 1 的总数。
统计 1 的总数 T；用滑动窗口求出所有长度为 k 的窗口中 1 的最少个数 q；输出 T+q×(q−1)/2，用 64 位整数。全为 0 时结果自然是 0。
en: Let q be the fewest 1s in any initial window of length k. However you operate, before the t-th operation at most t−1 ones have been removed, so the first q operations cost at least q, q−1, …, 1 in turn, and every later operation costs at least 1.

This bound is reachable: first keep choosing the window with the fewest 1s until it is clear, paying exactly q+(q−1)+…+1; then slide outward from that all-zero window one cell at a time, so each newly met 1 is the only 1 in its window and costs 1 to remove. The total is T+q(q−1)/2, where T is the number of 1s.
Count the total number of 1s, T; use a sliding window to find the minimum number q of 1s over all windows of length k; print T+q×(q−1)/2 as a 64-bit integer. An all-zero array naturally gives 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let T be the total number of 1s, and use a sliding window to find the minimum number q of 1s in any initial window of length k; return T+q(q−1)/2.

## Proof of correctness

Every initial window has at least q ones, and before the t-th operation at most t−1 have been removed, so the first q operations cost at least q,q−1,…,1, and every removal after that costs at least 1. Choosing the window with the fewest ones first and clearing it continuously pays exactly that triangular sum. Once a zero stretch of length k exists, extend it left and right one cell at a time; each newly reached 1 can be removed at cost 1 in a window whose other k−1 cells are already cleared, so the lower bound is reached. The fixed window length does not shrink at the edges of the array.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1) excluding the input; the answer uses 64 bits.
